alldatatypes.fgb, empty.fgb, heterogeneous.fgb, mp_overlapping.fgb,
no_properties.fgb, poly00.fgb and unknown_feature_count.fgb are copied
unmodified from the test data of the FlatGeobuf reference implementation (the
flatgeobuf/flatgeobuf repository, test/data/), and are distributed under its
licence below. (world_cities.fgb is not: it is this crate's writer's output for
../world_cities.csv, rebuilt by `FGB_BLESS=1 cargo test --lib fgb`.)
